entry.title: Missing Roseburg Man Found on Hillside After Search Team Discovers His Bag
entry.summary: A missing 73-year-old Roseburg man was found on a hillside Friday after search volunteers discovered his bag nearby. A sheriff’s office drone operator located him, and ground crews helped him to safety before he was reunited with his family.

entry.title: Douglas County Wildfire Project Receives $1.29 Million for Fuel Breaks
entry.summary: Douglas County’s Little River Landscape Resiliency Project will receive $1.29 million to create fuel breaks along Lane Mountain, the Little River drainage, and Cavitt Creek. The work is part of a $10 million state investment in wildfire risk reduction.

entry.title: Roseburg Council to Consider Restructuring or Dissolving Homeless Commission
entry.summary: Roseburg councilors agreed to consider restructuring or dissolving the Homeless Commission after debating its role and the pace of progress on homelessness. The motion schedules a future discussion; the commission remains in place.

entry.title: Roseburg Council Debates Flock Cameras; Temporary Suspension Motion Gets No Second
entry.summary: Roseburg councilors debated Flock cameras Monday, raising questions about privacy, security, and police use. Zack Weiss’s motion to consider a temporary suspension received no second. The council voted 6-2 to revisit the issue with more information.

entry.title: Woman Who Died in Yoncalla House Fire Identified
entry.summary: Authorities identified Carol Lorrain Most, 56, as the woman who died in Sunday’s house fire in Yoncalla. Another occupant escaped and received assistance. The Oregon State Fire Marshal’s Office is investigating the cause.

entry.title: Cool Start Gives Way to Warmer Weather in Roseburg This Week
entry.summary: Roseburg will warm from a high near 67 Monday to 74 Wednesday, with sunshine following chilly mornings and possible fog. Temperatures could reach 83 Thursday, while light rain may return early next week.
